benchmark_definition_commit: resolved from the immutable commit containing this specification
benchmark_hash_algorithm: sha256(cases.json bytes + evaluator.py bytes + runner.py bytes)
scoring_formula: weighted mean of case pass percentages by critical category
hard_fail_rules: candidate-introduced failure of any case that passed at baseline
unresolved failure of a case carrying hard_fail_class
benchmark definition or evaluator hash drift inside a comparison cycle
tie_break_rule: fewer changed configuration files, then fewer changed lines, then earlier retained iteration
variance_rule: deterministic Level A cases have zero expected variance; any repeated-run disagreement blocks comparison
evaluator_disagreement_rule: not applicable: one immutable deterministic evaluator; independent evaluation is UNVERIFIED
execution_environment: Python 3 standard library on repository checkout; UTF-8 files; no network or model required
holdout_location: NOT APPLICABLE for Level A-only claims; no holdout cases created
resource_budget: 30 CPU minutes and 250 MB local raw outputs
forbidden_files: Git history, tags, repository settings, permissions, visibility and branch protection
expected_blast_radius: Level A repository validation and narrowly evidenced project routing/governance text fixes only; no external ChatGPT Project mutation
